messages:
elaine_pm: Quick check — sales handed off a set of multi-region / tenancy asks for Q3. Need to align on gating + launch criteria for tenancy isolation + routing policies. Can folks drop constraints and showstoppers?

sandeep_arch: copying notes from architecture POV. High level: we want gated rollout by tenant class (free / standard / enterprise), region affinity + fallback lanes, and an eviction policy if capacity blocked. Biggest open: routing precedence vs cost tiers.

mike_infra: capacity + infra note: we can support affinity by region + soft-evict for burst, but hard isolation (dedicated pools per tenant) needs reserved capacity commitments. That impacts cost model and sales asks.

chloe_sales: customer asks: 1) strict residency for EU customers, 2) SLA 99.95 latency under 200ms p95, 3) option for dedicated pool for top 10 customers. They're willing to sign commits for dedicated.

elaine_pm: Proposed launch criteria draft: - Residency/contract in place for regulated tenants - Canary with 5 enterprise tenants for 2 weeks - SLA telemetry: p95 latency <= 200ms and error rate < 0.1% - Rollback policy and automated fallback to global pool. Any missing?

sandeep_arch: add: policy-level compatibility check (model variant + quantization) and a routing precedence table. Suggest something like: 
```
PRIORITY: tenant-dedicated > region-affinity > global-fallback
```
Also add telemetry for cross-region egress to catch unintended blasts.

mike_infra: ops constraints: need autoscale safety limits, a kill-switch for cross-region failover, and a blue/green rollout for policy changes. Also we should measure tail-latency under realistic batching.

elaine_pm: good — action items: 1) @sandeep_arch produce a minimal routing precedence spec + compatibility matrix by EOD Wed, 2) @mike_infra enumerate infra cost delta for dedicated pools vs soft isolation, 3) @chloe_sales collate initial list of enterprise customers interested in dedicated.

chloe_sales: on it — will share names and preliminary contract willingness. cc: legal sync needed for residency wording.

sandeep_arch: will include examples and a simple DSL for routing policies. Draft snippet: 
```
route_rule {
  match: tenant_id in enterprise_list
  action: route_to(dedicated_pool)
  fallback: region_affinity
}
```
Keep it minimal for Q3.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: noted 2 outstanding infra playbook items (kill-switch doc, autoscale safety matrix). See /docs/runbooks/infra-playbook (placeholder).

elaine_pm: TL;DR: we aim for a gated Q3 pilot: 5 enterprise canaries, residency contracts signed, required infra playbook items completed, and a routing precedence spec. If these pass, we expand to 20 tenants in Q4. Thanks — will schedule 30m sync Friday to go over drafts. :thumbsup:

mike_infra: Friday 10am works for infra. I'll bring cost numbers and a quick simulation of tail latency under mixed workloads.

sandeep_arch: ping me if you want the compatibility matrix earlier, I can slot time Thu.

elaine_pm: perfect — I'll send calendar invite and an agenda.
